items.title: AI Writing Humanizer
items.description: Humanizer skill at /home/desktop/clawd/skills/humanizer/SKILL.md removes signs of AI-generated writing from text. Based on Wikipedia's comprehensive 'Signs of AI writing' guide. Detects and fixes patterns including inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, negative parallelisms, and excessive conjunctive phrases.

items.title: Used for Hoscars Social Media Posts
items.description: Humanizer skill used on 2026-01-31 14:45 UTC to remove AI-generated patterns from Instagram thank-you posts for Hoscars awards (Best Hostel Thailand + Australia). Humanized version eliminated stiff corporate language and made copy sound more natural.

items.title: Final Post Without 'Bad Beds' Comments
items.description: After humanization, Trevor requested final version without 'bad beds' comments. Cleaned version focuses on community, guests from 80+ countries, and award achievement without mentioning accommodation quality issues.
